title: Chocolate Crust Cheesecake
description: A rich and creamy cheesecake with a crunchy chocolate crust. Perfect for dessert or snack time.
instructions: Prepare the crust by mixing biscuit crumbs and butter until well combined.
Press the crust mixture into a springform pan.
Bake the crust for 10 minutes, then set aside.
In a separate bowl, mix the cream cheese, sugar, eggs, and vanilla extract until smooth.
Pour the cheesecake mixture into the prepared pan over the crust.
Bake the cheesecake for 45 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 140°C (285°F) and bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Let the cheesecake cool in the oven with the door ajar for 10 minutes.
Remove the cheesecake from the oven and let it cool completely on a wire rack.
Once cooled, refrigerate the cheesecake for at least 4 hours before serving.
